definitions.explanation: A railway vehicle powered by electricity, used for public transportation. The most common word for train in everyday Japanese.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to work by train.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れています→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電車|でんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: What time is the next train?

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{十分|じっぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: After getting off the train, it's about a 10-minute walk.

notes:
{電車|でんしゃ} specifically means electric train, the most common type of train in urban Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {電車|でんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to get on/ride a train
- {電車|でんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to get off a train
- {電車|でんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go by train
- ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧: last train
- ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧{電車|でんしゃ}: first train

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧: train (generic/formal term)
- ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧: bullet train (shinkansen)
- ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧: subway
- ⟦{汽車|きしゃ}→汽車：01381_kisha⟧: steam train (old/rural)

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧{電車|でんしゃ} (packed train) is common during rush hour. Train punctuality in Japan is famous worldwide.
